name: Delhi University UGCF letter grades and CGPA

credit_system.conversion_notes: UGCF course credit patterns (4/2) are in Ordinance VIII addition tables.

gpa_formula.description: Standard credit-weighted CGPA. Final percentage for students graduating from 2022-23 = Grand CGPA × 10 (Ordinance VIII addition, clause 10).

repeat_course_rules.description: Ordinance VIII addition describes essential repeat / improvement pathways; the recorded grade after the allowed reappearance replaces the prior attempt for that component. Encoded as last-attempt pending fuller workflow modelling.

pass_fail.description: P is a letter grade with 4 points, not a GPA-excluded pass/fail option.

degree_classification.description: UGCF document defines letter/point table. Division names for NEP batches are not restated in the 10 Feb 2023 notification; CBCS divisions must not be assumed.

provenance.note: Do not apply CBCS First/Second/Third Division cut-offs to UGCF without a UGCF-specific ordinance.

official_sources.title: University of Delhi — Addition to Ordinance VIII (UGCF 2022 assessment), 10 February 2023

notes: CBCS batches used CGPA × 9.5 for percentage — that is a separate scheme (in-delhi-cbcs), not this record.
UGCF Table-1 letter grades as published in the framework: O=10 … P=4, F=0, Ab=0.
